name: What types of issues indicate a need for hardware or functional adjustments?
description: Doors sticking, windows difficult to open, squeaky hinges, or misaligned fixtures are common signs indicating a need for hardware or functional adjustments.

mainEntity.name: What types of issues indicate a need for hardware or functional adjustments?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common issues that indicate a need for adjustments include doors that stick or don't latch properly, windows that are difficult to open or close, cabinet drawers that don't glide smoothly, or hinges that squeak. Misaligned handles, loose fixtures, or components that don't sit flush can also signal a need for fine-tuning. Recognizing these signs early allows for timely intervention to prevent further wear or frustration. Clients should note these observations during walk-throughs, helping us efficiently address them.
